IC1: Category 1: Patients who live at home and meet the following criteria:
IC2: - CDC-defined CRE isolated during hospitalization [OR] or outpatient visit
IC4: - First positive CRE culture within 48 hours of admission (in case of hospitalization)
IC5: Category 2: Hospitalized patients [AND] with CDC-defined CRE isolated during hospitalization [AND] who are [NOT] not discharged home and who meet any of the following criteria:
IC6: - Admitted from other care facility (not home origin)
IC7: - Do [NOT] not have first positive CRE culture within 48 hours of admission
IC8: Category 3: Patients with CDC-defined CRE isolated during hospitalization or outpatient visit [AND] who are discharged home and who meet any of the following criteria:
IC9: - Admitted from other care facility (not home origin)
IC10: - Do [NOT] not have first positive CRE culture within 48 hours of admission (in case of hospitalization)
IC11: Category 4: Participants who meet the following criteria:
IC12: • Community contact of a participant in Category 1 and/or 3.
